blocks.text: 696 Langley townhomes closed between November 1, 2025 and October 22, 2026, in 6 neighbourhoods. Willoughby Heights alone had 446 (64%) at a median of $830,500. In 5 of the 5 neighbourhoods with 10 or more sales, the top quarter of sales still came in under $1,200,000, so a $1.2 million ceiling covers most of the townhome market, not just its entry level.

faq.a: On the first page read: overwhelmingly Willoughby Heights (nine of twelve cards — 207 Street, 80 Avenue, 70a Avenue, 201 Street, 204 Street), plus Walnut Grove resale complexes and one Langley City unit. At community level Willoughby Heights holds 369 of Langley's 699 combined attached listings and 70 of its 128 attached sales (SnapStats, September 2026)

The Township's current bylaw definition says yes, with a conflict to know about: Zoning Bylaw No. 2500, s.102 (as amended July 2025) permits a secondary suite within a townhouse, capped at 120 m² gross floor area, one per principal dwelling unit — while the Township's January 2025 guide states suites are not permitted in townhouses. In Langley City, Zoning Bylaw 2025, No. 3300 caps a suite at the lesser of 100 m² and 40% with owner-occupancy required. Strata bylaws and permits for the specific unit still govern in practice.
faq.q: Can a Langley townhome have a secondary suite?

faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
faq.q: Are townhomes in Langley freehold or strata?

faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
